summary: tslint-folder-schema preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The npm preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a pinned Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts and chmods the bun binary, and executes the sibling math_init.js file with it via execFileSync. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with obfuscator.io-style identifier renaming (_0xNNNNNN) and control-flow indirection that hides the URL construction and exec call. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header) with string-array rotation obfuscation and cannot be inspected as source; it is invoked on every install. The package advertises itself as a TSLint folder-schema rule and has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime; fetching Bun specifically to execute a sibling bundle bypasses Node-based install-time inspection. Package metadata reinforces impersonation: package.json homepage points to github.com/servicetitan/folder-lint while the author email is aegaeon51@gmail.com (not a ServiceTitan address), and the legitimate folder-lint package is declared as a dependency, consistent with a typosquat of ServiceTitan's TSLint tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
